title: Sometimes Movies make a deep impact on you.

commenti.body: I have a vivid memory of being maybe 10 years old and picking up a VHS of Princess Mononoke while wandering the shelves of the local library, thinking "this box art looks pretty cool" and convincing my mom to let me rent it. Completely blew my kid self away, not to say I went back and rented every critically acclaimed movie they had but it certainly made me aware of the magic of cinema and the way it can tell a story so powerfully. It might not be a perfect movie, or even Miyazaki's best, but it remains one of my favorites.
I really struggle why everyone added not Miyazaki'ss best when it is , or easily 50:50
I think it's just a mark of respect because there are so many good ones. I don't agree too much with spirited away being his best. Mononoke and totoro are it for me.

It's definitely among his best.  It's not my personal favorite (*Castle in the Sky*, followed closely by *Nausicaa of the Valley of the Wind*), but *Mononoke* feels like a better-constructed movie than just about anything else he's made.

I'd put it as his best but I usually see Spirited Away regarded as his most acclaimed work. You could make arguments for several of his movies being his "best" though, so it's really more of an academic exercise than actually meaningful.

I totally connect to the impact of certain movies, and how they're able to inspire us to make major life decisions. I also was deeply touched by The Tree of Life, and I somehow like that this is a deeply divisive film, and while some feel enlightened by it, others see it as a boring, unfocused mess. I first saw it a theaters with 2 friends that left midway through. 

For me, one of the movies that impacted me to change my life was Midnight in Paris. Not even my favorite Woody Allen movie, and certainly not his best when I think about his overall filmography. But I saw it in a time and place where it resonated with me. It assured me that's easy to romanticize the past and all that could have been, but that the good times are here and now. 

I wish you the best in this new phase of your life!
